# Contributing

Contributor rules (Conventional Commits, DCO sign-off, signed commits, branch naming, squash-only) are defined once for the whole org:

**→ [`NCKU-custos/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md`](https://github.com/NCKU-custos/.github/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)**

This file exists only as a pointer so contributors landing on this repo first don't have to hunt.

This repo's specific quirks (the bootstrap caveat for reusable workflows, lint-config publication via raw URLs, GHCR base image) are in [`CLAUDE.md`](../CLAUDE.md) and the relevant ADRs in [`custos-bringup/docs/adr/`](https://github.com/NCKU-custos/custos-bringup/tree/main/docs/adr) — most relevantly ADR 0009 (cross-repo CI) and ADR 0011 (ROS2 Lyrical / Ubuntu 26.04).
